sections.name: Local News
sections.description: Events and affairs in the Richmond area and Virginia (with the Washington, DC region as a close second) — city hall, schools, courts, transit, housing, weather, and daily life as it happens; the center is what occurred locally, not the politics around it.

sections.name: Local Politics
sections.description: The contest for power and policy locally — Richmond city council and mayor, Virginia General Assembly and governor's office, DC government, local elections, zoning fights, and regional political movements; the center is the political fight itself.
